hero.intro: A life in hospitality, shaped by fermentation, sustainability, and the people gathered around the table.

about.title: A life built around hospitality.
paragraphs: My journey in the bar scene began in Rome, where I balanced childhood dreams with hard work. At 13, I became captivated by the guitar while helping my mother at her fish stand. At 14, I stepped into the busy bar culture of Via Serpenti, making cappuccinos every day. The work taught me discipline and a strong work ethic.

At 15, I was making aperitivi and learning to make guests feel valued. At 18, I moved to the United Kingdom, learned to live independently, and worked my way up to group bar manager in Manchester while competing in the cocktail scene.

My journey brought me to Toronto and Mother Cocktail Bar, which I co-own. We put fermentation, innovative cocktails, and honest, humble guest service at the heart of what we do. I was named Canada’s World Class Bartender of the Year in 2022, ICCO Best Cocktail Bartender in 2023, and Canada’s official World Class Coach in 2023 and 2024—leading Canada to the World Title both years.

Over the past four years, I have travelled to many countries to share my love of hospitality, cocktail-making, and fermentation. My story is one of craftsmanship and resilience—and a belief that the journey and the company matter as much as the destination.
about.quote: “I train like I’ve never won, and I compete like I’ve never lost.” — Eileen Gu
about.summary: From the bars of Rome to co-owning Mother Cocktail Bar in Toronto, Massi’s journey is built around craft, resilience, and making every guest feel valued.

essays.title: A way of life
paragraphs: Many people see fermentation as a preserving technique our ancestors developed to survive. I see it as much more: a way of life that deepens our understanding of how food and drink are made.

There is something incredible about creating from scratch, with love and care at every step. Think of bread, koji, or kombucha: simple grains, rice, or sweet tea become warm loaves, layers of flavour, and lively bubbles. That process sparks my curiosity—and I have not regretted a second of this journey.

essays.title: Sustain yourself first
paragraphs: Sustainability is often discussed as reusing, instead of first preventing waste. Each of us has a different approach. Mine is simple: “If you cannot sustain yourself, it’s unlikely you will sustain the people around you.”

Your body, mind, surroundings, and especially your time are essential to living sustainably and sharing that practice. The message can take root in your community, reach others, and help create a chain of more sustainable living on our planet.

essays.title: The menu is a secret
paragraphs: Before opening Mother Cocktail Bar, I dreamed of collaborating with chefs on food-and-cocktail pairings. When that did not go to plan, I started a side project bringing food and cocktails together in culinary events.
What if guests did not know the menu until they sat down? The mystery made the experience more challenging and personal. That idea gave the series its name: SECRET DINERS.

After almost 35 events, we brought the dinners to restaurants, bars, and art galleries, collaborating with talented chefs. What began as a joke became one of the projects I am proudest of professionally.

essays.title: A new wave of cocktail-making
paragraphs: Co-owned by bartender and bar operator Massimo Zitti, Mother Cocktail Bar is on Queen Street West in Toronto. It is a destination for innovative, fermentation-driven cocktails where hospitality meets sustainability and humble guest service. Mother ranked No. 7 on Canada’s Best 100 in 2023 and No. 37 on North America’s 50 Best Bars.

Mother began in 2019 with like-minded people who believed Toronto needed something new and different. Over time, this small cocktail bar became an internationally recognised destination for a new wave of cocktail-making, avant-garde drink techniques, and flavour discovery.
What makes Massi proudest is seeing staff and guests enjoy themselves, respect one another during service, and watching talented young professionals grow in their craft.

Mother has collaborated with Handshake Speakeasy (Mexico City), Overstory (New York), Odd Couple (Shanghai), Passing Fancies (UK), Double Chicken Please, Gokan, Punch Room at Edition Hotel Tokyo, Nutmeg & Clove, and many others.

Massimo’s milestones: Canada World Class Bartender of the Year (2022); ICCO Best Cocktail Bartender (2023); and Canada’s official World Class Coach (2023 and 2024), leading Canada to win the World Title both years.
